evidence.quote: Antibody response to vaccination was assessed using serum samples obtained at day 0 and 28 using a standard hemagglutination inhibition assay (Frey et al., 2010 ).

flow cytometry.platform: Fortessa instrument (Becton Dickinson) or CytoFlex LX instrument (Beckman Coulter)
flow cytometry.readouts: surface expression of platelet activation markers and percentage of CD41+CD40L+, CD41+CD62P+, and CD41+CD63+ particles

evidence.quote: Samples are washed with 1X FACS buffer again to remove the PFA and finally re‐suspended in 1 × FACS buffer for flow cytometry analysis using either Fortessa instrument (Becton Dickinson) or CytoFlex LX instrument (Beckman Coulter) fitted with an automated sampler accommodating 96‐well plates. FCS files generated by the BD FACS DeVa software (Bd Bio Sciences) or CytExpert software (Beckman Coulter) were analyzed using FlowJo software V10. (FlowJo, LLC). Particles recorded in log scale forward and side scatter (FCS and SSC) were distinguished as anucleate platelets by the surface expression of CD41+ and CD61+. The activation status of platelets was further estimated as percentage of CD41+ CD40L+, CD41+CD62P+ and CD41+CD63+ particles.

RNA‐seq.platform: Takara Bio SMARTer Stranded Total RNA‐Seq‐kit ‐ Pico Input Mammalian; Illumina NovaSeq 6000, S4 flowcell, 2 × 100 paired‐end
RNA‐seq.readouts: platelet RNA expression levels and gene counts

evidence.quote: RNA‐seq libraries were prepared using the Takara Bio SMARTer Stranded Total RNA‐Seq‐kit ‐ Pico Input Mammalian per the manufacturer's instructions. Libraries were sequenced on an Illumina NovaSeq 6000, S4 flowcell, 2 × 100 paired‐end, following the manufacturer's protocols.
